evals.prompt: We want to clarify a delivery-status page and eventually save it for Impeccable. There is no installed Impeccable executable in this fixture, and installation or filesystem searches outside the supplied project are not authorized. Only this new interview skill is available, with no other interview skill or wiki. Please continue without installing anything, without trying another workflow, and without writing project files. The requester says customers should check whether their delivery date changed, with no accounts or identity collection. They have not spoken to customers and have not chosen exact dates versus ranges. They ask to stop interviewing now and receive a provisional brief. Give the brief, name what cannot be saved, and do not ask more questions.
evals.expected_output: Returns a conversation-only provisional task brief, preserves privacy and unresolved date precision, separates requester intent from customer evidence, and states that saving is unavailable because the Impeccable prerequisite is missing. Does not install, search elsewhere, invoke another skill, invent paths, or write project artifacts.
expectations: Produces a provisional conversation-only brief and honors the stop request without another interview question.
Names the missing Impeccable prerequisite and states that no brief was saved, without inventing a saved path.
Preserves no-account/no-identity constraints and unresolved exact dates versus ranges, and treats the customer need as requester intent rather than observed customer evidence.
Leaves the fixture project unchanged and does not install, search outside the authorized scope, or invoke another workflow or interview skill.
